originality.rationale: The complete motivating source states the stationary cubic and sufficient small-disagreement contraction but not unconditional uniqueness, log-metric quantitative two-sided bracketing, or global reduced-flow exponential convergence for arbitrary strictly one-sign opinions. General nonlinear Perron-Frobenius results cover abstract iterated-map ideas but not this complete parameter-free concrete theorem with explicit bounds. Published claim queries and accessible historical claims did not imply the theorem; an inaccessible June follow-up and unindexed equivalents remain risks.
residual_risks: The 2026-06-04 same-author follow-up was not accessible in full, though the available governing equation differs.
An unindexed equivalent using standard positive-map machinery cannot be excluded.
The result deliberately does not establish global stability of the original finite-speed coupled ODE.

The unconditional stationary uniqueness, reproducible certified two-sided enclosure and uniform fast-leadership relaxation are nontrivial structural guarantees, with a rational example outside the original sufficient regime. Qualitative mathematical methods themselves are standard.
